rec.name: Cart Drawer Revision: Social-Proof Upsell Carousel with Variant Popup, Reservation Timer and Trust Strip
rec.status: Built — A/B test launched; Instagram in-app browser bugs fixed

what.text: A revised cart drawer (the 'Revision' variant in an A/B test for the client GIVE LOVE). From the screenshots it contains: (1) a pink banner at the top, 'Your cart is reserved for 05:55 minutes', with a countdown; (2) the line item with a sale price (€34.90, struck-through €49.90) and a quantity stepper; (3) an upsell block headed 'Fits perfectly / 8 out of 10 customers also buy', with a product thumbnail, name, a black ADD button and a carousel with prev/next arrows. The comments say the upsell opens a variant-selection popup; (4) a summary with the items total, an applied discount code line, a subtotal and a note 'Discount codes in the next step'; (5) a full-width 'To checkout' CTA; (6) payment icons (Klarna, PayPal, Sofort, Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay); (7) two trust chips, 'Lifetime guarantee' and '30-day return policy'. The ticket has no description. The exact differences from the control are not documented.

why.text: Each part targets a different hesitation at the cart. The reservation timer adds mild urgency to finish checkout. The 'X out of 10 customers also buy' headline is a social-proof cue that makes the cross-sell feel like a normal, validated choice. A one-click add with a variant popup keeps the add-on low-friction and raises AOV. The trust chips and payment icons right next to the checkout CTA reduce risk and payment anxiety. Showing the struck-through price and savings anchors perceived value.

how.text: Build it as a custom cart drawer (Liquid plus JS). Render a countdown banner at the top of the drawer. Below the line items, add a recommendation carousel with a headline and a social-proof subline. Each card shows an image, title, price (with compare-at price and savings if on sale) and an ADD button. For products with variants, the button opens a variant-selection popup or bottom sheet that covers the lower drawer area and uses the cart's font. Below the totals, add the checkout CTA, a row of payment icons and 2 trust chips. Test the drawer in the Instagram in-app browser on iPhone. Comments report arrows rendering wrongly, the popup not overlaying the bottom area, the popup rendering wrongly when the cart is re-opened after closing, and a font mismatch in the popup. All were fixed.

items: Reservation timer on/off, duration (screenshots show about 6 and 10 minutes) and message text
Banner background colour (pink in the screenshots)
Upsell headline and social-proof subline text (e.g. 'X out of 10 customers also buy')
Upsell product source (manual or recommendation logic) and number of carousel items
Variant-selection popup on/off for multi-variant add-ons
Show compare-at price and 'You save' amount on upsell cards
Discount code line and 'Discount codes in the next step' note

dependencies.text: A custom or heavily modified cart drawer with JS (cart AJAX API). The upsell products and the 'X out of 10' figure probably come from metafields, collections or an app, but the source is not stated. The popup needs the theme's cart font. The element must be tested in the Instagram in-app browser (iOS WebView), as the client's traffic comes from there. No apps are named in the ticket.

items: Conversion rate on Instagram in-app browser traffic (check for rendering issues)

images.caption: Final cart drawer in the Instagram browser on iPhone: reservation timer banner, 'Fits perfectly / 8 out of 10 customers also buy' upsell with ADD button, summary with discount code line, checkout CTA, payment icons and trust chips (lifetime guarantee, 30-day returns). The carousel arrows show as grey placeholder circles here.

Same drawer with the carousel arrows rendered and the upsell price shown with a strike-through and 'You save €15.00'. The upper area is dimmed, which may be an overlay or popup state, so this is uncertain.
